problem.passage:
Voyager 1, launched by NASA in 1977, was originally designed to study Jupiter and Saturn during a five-year mission. After completing its planetary flybys, however, the spacecraft continued transmitting data as it traveled outward through the solar system, and in 2012 it became the first human-made object to cross the heliopause into interstellar space. __Because its instruments were built with far more durability than its original mission required, Voyager 1 has continued sending back measurements of cosmic rays and magnetic fields more than four decades after its launch.__ Scientists now rely on this unplanned extension of the mission to study conditions in interstellar space that no other spacecraft has directly measured.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
problem.stimulus: Voyager 1, launched by NASA in 1977, was originally designed to study Jupiter and Saturn during a five-year mission. After completing its planetary flybys, however, the spacecraft continued transmitting data as it traveled outward through the solar system, and in 2012 it became the first human-made object to cross the heliopause into interstellar space. __Because its instruments were built with far more durability than its original mission required, Voyager 1 has continued sending back measurements of cosmic rays and magnetic fields more than four decades after its launch.__ Scientists now rely on this unplanned extension of the mission to study conditions in interstellar space that no other spacecraft has directly measured.
problem.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: To explain why a spacecraft has been able to provide scientifically valuable data long after its intended mission ended
To describe a design flaw that unexpectedly extended the spacecraft's operational lifespan
To compare Voyager 1's durability with that of later spacecraft launched by NASA
To conclude that space agencies should prioritize durability over cost in future spacecraft design
problem.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 Voyager 1이 왜 예정된 임무 이후에도 오랫동안 유용한 데이터를 계속 보낼 수 있었는지 그 이유(내구성 있게 설계된 장비)를 설명한다. 이는 이어지는 문장에서 과학자들이 이 '계획되지 않은 임무 연장'을 활용한다는 내용과 연결되므로 A가 정답이다. B는 '결함(flaw)'이라는 표현으로 긍정적 설계 특성을 부정적으로 왜곡한 오답이다. C는 지문에 언급되지 않은 다른 우주선과의 비교를 지어낸 오답이다. D는 밑줄 문장 하나의 기능이 아니라 지문 전체에서 도출되지 않는 정책적 결론을 지어낸 오답이다.
problem.explanationEn: The underlined sentence explains why Voyager 1 was able to keep sending useful data long after its planned mission ended—because its instruments were built more durably than required. This connects to the following sentence about scientists using this unplanned mission extension, making A correct. B distorts a positive design feature into a 'flaw,' reversing the intended meaning. C fabricates a comparison with other spacecraft that is never mentioned in the passage. D invents a policy conclusion that is not the function of this single sentence and is not supported by the passage as a whole.
problem.evidenceSpan: Because its instruments were built with far more durability than its original mission required, Voyager 1 has continued sending back measurements of cosmic rays and magnetic fields more than four decades after its launch.
problem.answerRationale: 밑줄 문장은 앞서 언급된 임무 연장이라는 사실에 대해 '왜' 그것이 가능했는지(내구성 있는 설계) 설명하는 근거이며, 이는 뒤 문장에서 언급되는 과학자들의 지속적 활용을 뒷받침한다.

difficultyReasons: 필요한 추론은 밑줄 문장이 앞뒤 문맥에서 어떤 기능을하는지 파악하는 1단계 수준
핵심 관계는 원인(내구성)-결과(장기간 데이터 전송)의 단순한 인과관계로 미묘하지 않음
오답 B는 '결함'이라는 단어로 정답과 표면적 정보를 일부 공유하지만 나머지 두 오답은 지문과 무관해 쉽게 배제 가능
별도의 자료나 수식 해석이 필요 없음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 밑줄 문장이 '내구성이 원래 요구된 것보다 훨씬 뛰어났다'는 내용을 담고 있어 '설계 결함'과 혼동할 수 있음
distractors.matches: instruments were built with far more durability than its original mission required 구절
distractors.whyWrong: 내구성이 뛰어난 것은 결함이 아니라 의도된 견고한 설계이며, 지문 어디에도 '결함(flaw)'이라는 부정적 뉘앙스는 없음

distractors.plausibleBecause: NASA가 언급되어 다른 우주선과의 비교를 떠올릴 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 지문에는 후속 우주선과의 비교가 전혀 등장하지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 내구성 덕분에 임무가 연장되었다는 내용을 미래 정책 제안으로 확대 해석할 수 있음
distractors.matches: durability라는 단어와 그로 인한 긍정적 결과
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 결론이나 제안이 아니라 단순히 현재 상황을이유를 설명하는 서술문임. 정책 제안은 지문에 없음
